<\STATESEP>section "Bitwise tactic for Signed Words"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>theory Bitwise_Signed
imports
  "HOL-Library.Word"
  Bitwise
  Signed_Words
begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>ML \<open>fun bw_tac_signed ctxt = let
  val (ss, sss) = Word_Bitwise_Tac.expand_word_eq_sss
  val sss = nth_map 2 (fn ss => put_simpset ss ctxt addsimps @{thms len_signed} |> simpset_of) sss
in
    foldr1 (op THEN_ALL_NEW)
      ((CHANGED o safe_full_simp_tac (put_simpset ss ctxt)) ::
        map (fn ss => safe_full_simp_tac (put_simpset ss ctxt)) sss)
  end;
\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>method_setup word_bitwise_signed =
  \<open>Scan.succeed (fn ctxt => Method.SIMPLE_METHOD (bw_tac_signed ctxt 1))\<close>
  "decomposer for word equalities and inequalities into bit propositions on concrete word lengths"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>end<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>
